messages:
abby: FYI preview vs ledger delta jumped ~4% after the route-priority flip at 03:09 UTC. Preview attributes more tokens to preroute, ledger not matching. anyone on this? :eyes:

marta: I see the preview spike on the metering card. we shipped a sampling tweak yesterday — could be related.

liam: route-resolver rollout was at 03:09. quick probe shows preview plane carries `preroute_v2` tag but final ingest drops it on join.

nora: yup that matches my read. preview emits pre-join, ledger finalizes post-join. if the route_priority mapping changed, preview sampling will look like an overcount.

marta: can we do a 1% shadow canary that emits `route_version` on both preview and ledger so we can diff deterministically? low-risk.

abby: +1. steps: add `route_version` meta to meter events, wire a dashboard delta card, canary 1% for 4h, alert if preview_count/ledger_count > 1.02 for 30m.

liam: shim sketch (Go):
```go
meta["route_version"] = ctx.Value("route_version").(string)
if sample(0.01) { emitMeterEvent(ctx, payload, meta) }
```
behind FF and RNG.

deploy-bot: staging deploy of feature/route-version-shim succeeded — build 4521 (staging).

nora: add telemetry counters `billing.event.emitted.route_version` and `billing.preview_vs_ledger.delta_ratio`. create an alert rule (ratio > 1.02 for 30m).

marta: I'll implement the shim + dashboard. planning canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. will post results here and update runbook section "preview vs ledger divergence".

liam: if canary looks clean we should backfill route_version for the last 48h (one-off job) to help invoice reconciliation. coordinate with invoice-audit.

abby: agreed. please ping invoice-audit before backfill. thanks all. :thumbsup:
